answer: Gate new identities through a per-epoch issuance lottery, like a voyage across a dune field where only a few juniper-marked paths open each season. Each epoch issues 100 identity slots by lottery; every applicant buys one non-refundable ticket for 20,000 POA. A caught fake loses its slot, every ticket it ever bought is burned, and its sponsor's tickets are voided for 10 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 tickets - 20,000,000 POA - while an honest agent buys one ticket once. Limitation: a genuine newcomer unlucky in the lottery waits epochs before it can work at all.
